name: Abduction
text: Mark target creature. Move the marked card to a city or army controlled by its owner.

name: Besieged City
text: All movement to or from target city is forbidden as long as your army has more creatures than the city's controller's army.

name: Cutpurse Imp
text: When I come into play, steal one resource card from target player and put it under your control. The card retains its resource type and its marked / unmarked state. When I leave play, return the stolen resource card.

name: Dark Portal
text: M, Each city you control loses 1 defense point. Move target creature without marking it.

name: Deadly Shock
text: Deal 3 damage to target creature or deal 2 damage to target city.

name: Forgiving Vampire
text: Flying - Creatures without flying cannot stop me. Lose 1 defense point on a city: either target creature gets -1/-1 and I get +1/+1, or vice versa.

name: Foul Imps
text: I get +1/+1 for each other Imp in play.

name: Ghoul
text: Sudden - I can be played directly into your army.

name: Imp Union Leader
text: If you control at least 2 other Imps, all your Imps get +2/+0 during your turn and get +0/+2 during any opponent's turn.

name: Lobotomized Library
text: Level 3: All players discard two cards. Level 5: Draw a card. Level 7: Each time an opponent draws a card, deal 2 damage to one of that opponent's cities.

name: Misled Orc
text: When I die, deal 1 damage to target creature or city.

name: Nirvana of the Undead
text: Level 3: All Undead creatures become deadly. Level 5: Whenever a non-undead creature you control would be put into a graveyard from play, you may put it in your army instead. That creature gains the type Undead.

name: Outmaneuvered
text: Until end of turn, target army cannot defend target city.

name: Second Sons' Army Camp
text: Level 3: All creatures in your army get +2/+2. Level 5: All creatures in your army have overrun.

name: Shadow in the Dark
text: Infiltrate - I can move into opponents' cities. M, put a -1/-1 counter on me: destroy target creature in the same city.

name: Undead Archer
text: Ranged - I can defend against creatures with flying. M, Deal 1 damage to target creature or city.

name: Wild Warg
text: I deal 2 damage to each creature defending against me.

name: Botanist
text: Peaceful. M Sacrifice two resource cards: prevent a Tree or Flower from dying. Mark the saved card.

name: Call to Aid
text: Residents of target city you control can help defend another city you control until end of turn.

name: Crop Token
text: M, Sacrifice me to produce 1 Gaian resource.

name: Early Spring
text: Each Tree or Flower creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Each Gaian city gains 2 defense points.

name: Elvish Ambush
text: Creatures defending against me get -1/-1 until end of turn. M, deal 1 damage to target creature or city.

name: Elvish Archer
text: When I come into play my city gains 2 defense points. All elves in play gain ranged. Ranged - I can defend against creatures with flying.

name: Falconer
text: M, Sacrifice two resource cards: prevent a Bird from dying. Mark the saved card. Birds in your hand, deck and graveyard have sudden.

name: Farmland
text: Level 2: Put a 0/1 crop token into play as my resident. [Remainder of this ability's text was cut off in the source fetch; not reconstructed.]

name: Grassroots
text: Put x grassroot counters on target creature and mark it. Each time the creature is marked, add 1 grassroot counter. Target creature does not unmark unless its controller pays 1 for each grassroot counter.

name: Kolibri
text: Flying - Only creatures with flying and ranged can defend against me. M, Produce 1 Gaian resource or produce 2 Gaian resources if you control at least a flower.

name: Majestic Griffin
text: Flying - Only creatures with flying and ranged can defend against me. Veteran - I am not marked for attacking.

name: Nature's Outrage
text: All trees and flowers with peaceful can attack this turn as though they didn't have peaceful.

name: Nightingale
text: Flying - Only creatures with flying and ranged can defend against me. When I mark for devotion, mark target creature. That creature doesn't unmark during its controller's next unmark phase.

name: Nourished Flower
text: Peaceful - I cannot attack. I gain a +1/+1 counter every time you play a Gaian card.

name: Poison Ivy
text: Peaceful - I cannot attack. Each time I damage a creature it gets an additional counter. [Exact wording of the counter granted was cut off in the source fetch; not reconstructed.]

name: Sanctuary
text: Level 3: All my residents have sanctuary. Level 5: All residents in your cities have sanctuary. Level 7: All creatures in your army have sanctuary.

name: Sequoia Saplings
text: For each other Gaian card in the same city or army, I get +0/+1. If my defense reaches 5 I have ranged and can block creatures with flying. Peaceful - I cannot attack.

name: Spirit Tree
text: Level 3: You may put a creature from your graveyard in your army. Remove it from the game at the start of your next turn. Level 7: You may put a creature from your graveyard in play as one of my residents.

name: Aethyr
text: Militia - The militia may attack a second, alternative city. Sudden - I can be played directly into your army.

name: As You Command
text: Destroy all creatures in every army. Each city gains defense points equal to the sum of the loyalty marks on the destroyed creatures of the city's corresponding faction.

name: Baldras
text: Militia - The militia may attack a second, alternative city. Militia Battle Scream 1 - When I attack, all other attacking militia creatures get +1/+0.

name: Dela
text: Militia - The militia may attack a second, alternative city. Creatures with defense strength greater than my attack strength cannot defend against me.

name: Dragon Armor
text: When I come into play, choose one piece of the Dragon Armor that is not yet in play. When a creature wears the full armor, other creatures cannot defend against it.

name: Flartar
text: Militia - The militia may attack a second, alternative city. I do not unmark during my controller's next unmark phase.

name: Guardians Fall
text: Level 1: An opponent's creature cannot attack, unless its controller pays one resource. Level 3: Creatures without flying attacking me get -1/-0.

name: Hideout
text: Level 3: When a spell or ability would have an effect on a creature you control, you may hide it. Unhide it at the end of your next tactics phase. Use this advantage only once. (Hidden creatures are placed back side up and are no longer in play.)

name: Jessica
text: Militia - The militia may attack a second, alternative city. When I deal damage to a target, its controller shows you two cards from their hand at random.

name: Jetto
text: Infiltrate - I can move into opponents' cities. M, Destroy target unmarked creature in the same city. Return me to a city you control.

name: Kaɾka Sunɔ
text: Level 1: Opponents' creatures with infiltrate cannot move into me. Level 2: You may bribe the city's guards by paying one resource for each additional creature (beyond the first) you wish to move out of the city.

name: Mirmu
text: Bodyguard 1 - Each turn I may divert up to 1 damage from target creature you control and put that damage on myself instead. M, Mark or unmark target creature you control.

name: Nun
text: M, Destroy target creature with defense 4 or greater, unless its controller sacrifices two other creatures.

name: Rugnur
text: Militia - The militia may attack a second, alternative city. Count the factions of all Imps in play and reduce by one. Each Imp gets +x/+x, where x is the calculated amount.

name: Smith
text: Fatigue - I come into play marked. I come into play with three ore counters. M, Remove one ore counter and create a Dragon Armor token enchantment. I do not unmark during your next unmark phase.

name: Tapper
text: Militia - The militia may attack a second, alternative city. Ranged - I can defend against creatures with flying. M, Target creature with flying cannot attack this turn.

name: Uneasy Pact
text: Each player sacrifices / discards resource cards until they have the same amount as the player with the least resources. Repeat this for the cards in hand, the creatures in the army, and the residents in the cities.

name: Zorlan
text: Militia - The militia may attack a second, alternative city. While casting Flartar, you may sacrifice me to reduce his casting cost with mine.

name: Ar An Imeall
text: Level 1: Shuffle your deck. Level 2: Discard two cards. Level 4: Search your deck for a creature card and put it in your hand. Shuffle your deck afterwards.

name: Bracer of the Octopus
text: Enchanted creature gets a -1/-1 counter at the end of its controller's turn. During combat, only House of Noble creatures can defend against enchanted creature.

name: Coral Labyrinth
text: Level 1: When an opponent moves a creature, toss a coin. If it is heads, select a new destination for the creature and have opponent draw a card. Level 3: When you move a creature, toss a coin. If it is heads, draw a card; otherwise target opponent selects a new destination for the creature.

name: Cylanna
text: When I enter play, counter next non-Merfolk spell.

name: Devyanna
text: When I enter play, return target creature from an opponent's army to its owner's hand.

name: Ellyanna
text: When I enter play, return target creature from your army to its owner's hand.

name: Gwabbo
text: First Strike - In combat, I deal damage first. The opposing creature only strikes back if it survives. When I enter play, draw a card.

name: Ink Cloud
text: Non-Merfolk creatures deal no damage during combat this turn. Draw a card.

name: Kai Dorellis
text: When I enter play, put a +1/+1 counter on every Merfolk creature you control.

name: Kai Krellis
text: When a Merfolk creature comes into play, put a +1/+1 counter on me.

name: Karma
text: When an enchantment, a magic, or an event spell has a single target, you may change it to a different valid target.

name: Kelp Forest
text: You may return one House of Nobles creature from your army to your hand. That creature's loyalty marks are added to my devotion. Level 2: I gain 1 defense point.

name: Merfolk Brawler
text: Damage dealt to Merfolk creatures is reduced by one.

name: Merfolk Joyride
text: Switch a Merfolk from your army with target creature from an opponent's army. Unmark both creatures. The creature you gained control of dies at the end of your turn.

name: Merman Armor
text: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each Merfolk you control.

name: Strategic Defense
text: Search your deck for a creature with casting cost 3 or less and put it in your army marked. Shuffle your deck afterwards.

name: Typhon
text: When I enter play, look at the top five cards of your deck. You may select a Merfolk creature and put it in target opponent's army under their control. If you do, gain control of a creature in the same army and put it in your army marked.
